mapper.select:
SELECT SUM(cashflow) dealamt,CCY ccy,PROD_ID FROM (SELECT SUM( CASE prdeal.TRADE_TYPE WHEN '03' THEN (ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0)+ifnull(prdeal.REDEMPTION_FEE,0)) * -1 WHEN '04' THEN 0 WHEN '05' THEN 0 WHEN '14' THEN 0 WHEN '15' THEN 0 WHEN '16' THEN ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0) * -1 WHEN '17' THEN (ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0)+ifnull(prdeal.REDEMPTION_FEE,0)) * -1 ELSE ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0) END) cashflow, prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_deal prdeal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=prdeal.PROD_ID and prd.status!='D' WHERE PAY_DATE =#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND TRADE_TYPE NOT IN ('05','14','15') and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND PRDEAL.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM( CASE prdeal.TRADE_TYPE WHEN '04' THEN ifnull(prdeal.INT_AMT, 0) * -1 ELSE 0 END) cashflow, prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_deal prdeal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=prdeal.PROD_ID and prd.status!='D' WHERE INTEREST_DATE=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND PRDEAL.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM(-1*ifnull(fee.AMT,0 ))cashflow, fee.CCY,fee.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_fee_deal fee left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=fee.PROD_ID and prd.status!='D' WHERE fee.PAY_DATE =#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND fee.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY fee.CCY,fee.PROD_ID ) base
where PROD_ID in
#{prodid}
GROUP BY CCY,PROD_ID

SELECT sum( case when deal.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','03','05','08','10','12') then -1*ifnull(deal.AMT,0) else ifnull(deal.AMT,0) end ) dealamt ,DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY FROM chb_invest_trade deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status!='D' where deal.CHL_CPCT_ID is null and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and deal.DEALDATE =#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and deal.STATUS!='D'
and DEAL.PROD_ID in
#{prodid}
group by DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY

FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA_NOBTM

and PROD_ID in
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

#{assetcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT NULL POSUUID,/*头寸ID:自动生成*/ ASSETBASIS.PROD_ID PROD_ID,/*产品代码*/ ASSETBASIS.ASSET_ID ASSET_CODE,/*资产代码*/ NULL INVEST_TYPE,/*投资类型*/ NULL CHL_ID,/*通道代码*/ 0 DEALAMT,/*交易金额*/ 0 DEALQTY,/*交易份额*/
case when ASSETINFO.ASSET_TYPE2='1405' then IFNULL(ASSETBASIS.TDY_INTINCEXP,0) else ifnull(ASSETBASIS.TDY_COST_AMT,0) + ifnull(ASSETBASIS.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0) + ifnull(ASSETBASIS.TDY_INTINCEXP,0) /* + ifnull(ASSETBASIS.DELAY_PAY_AMT,0)*/ end ACCUAMT,/*剩余金额*/
case when ASSETINFO.ASSET_TYPE!='07' then ASSETBASIS.POS_AMT else ifnull(ASSETBASIS.TDY_COST_AMT,0) + ifnull(ASSETBASIS.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0) + ifnull(ASSETBASIS.TDY_INTINCEXP,0) /*+ ifnull(ASSETBASIS.DELAY_PAY_AMT,0)*/ end ACCUAMT,/*剩余份额*/
ASSETBASIS.POS_AMT ACCUQTY,/*剩余本金*/ ASSETBASIS.VALUE_DATE CDATE,/*生成日*/ NULL ORG_CODE,/*机构代码*/ NULL DEPT_CODE,/*部门代码*/ NULL CREATE_USER,/*创建人*/ NULL CREATE_TIME,/*创建时间*/ NULL UPDATE_USER,/*更新人*/ NULL UPDATE_TIME,/*更新时间*/ (case ifnull(ASSETINFO.ASSET_TYPE,'NULLASSET') when '12' then '05' when '15' then '01' when '16' then '05' when '19' then '05' when 'NULLASSET' then 'NULLASSET' else '01' end) as TRADE_TYPE, /*交易类型:关联资产要素信息表，判断ASSET_TYPE字段的值，若为12,16,19则该字段存05，否则存01*/ '02' IS_UNDER_TRADE,/*是否底层交易流水:02 否*/ NULL INVEST_VARIETY,/*投资品种 01债券 02ABS*/ ASSETBASIS.CCY CCY/*币种:关联资产要素信息表CHB_ASSET_INFO得到币种CCY*/
FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA ASSETBASIS
FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA_NOBTM ASSETBASIS
LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO ASSETINFO ON ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE = ASSETBASIS.ASSET_ID WHERE 1 =1 AND ASSETBASIS.STATUS != 'D'/*删除状态数据不统计*/ AND ASSETINFO.STATUS != 'D' AND DATE_FORMAT(ASSETBASIS.VALUE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
and ASSETBASIS.PROD_ID in
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and ASSETBASIS.ASSET_ID in
#{assetcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
